requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Implement new NGB keyed bottles with a page yield of 6,000 for black and 6,000 for CMY, and bottle size for CMY greater than 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: High page yield bottles reduce frequency of replacement, enhance customer convenience, and align with market expectations for CISS printers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: The printer must accept new NGB keyed bottles and achieve at least 6,000 pages for black and CMY, and CMY bottle size must support >8,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Design the ink bottle and tank interface to ensure spill-free reliability during user refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents mess and improves user experience, critical for consumer and SMB segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank mechanical design, NOA-F integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage observed in 100 consecutive refill cycles under standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining current click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security, tamper evidence, and product integrity.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, supply chain for metal foiling
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All NOA-F units must pass tamper evidence and sealing tests as per HP standards.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D cost, speeds time-to-market, and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: The new printer must operate reliably using existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks without any reformulation.

requirements.Title: Enhanced Reliability and Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Perform comprehensive reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life scenarios. Model ink stability in tank and its impact on print quality.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent performance, longevity, and print quality throughout product life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reliability and stability models must predict at least 95% uptime and consistent PQ (Print Quality) over 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Support for Service Parts and Warranty
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for in-warranty support, and the system must support customer-replaceable PHA and NOA-F.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F and PHA must be replaceable by customers or service centers, and available as service parts within warranty period.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 feature on the bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: Supports authentication and anti-counterfeit measures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All bottles must have Acumen 6 feature validated in production samples.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line to accommodate NOA-F requirements, and add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing capability for new product configurations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production lines must be validated and able to produce new configurations at planned capacity.

requirements.Title: New Keyed Caps Mold Tooling
requirements.Description: Invest in mold tooling for 1 to 4 new keyed bottle caps.
requirements.Rationale: Supports differentiation and compatibility control for new bottle types.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mold tools must be delivered and pass first article inspection for all new cap designs.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt LE / Marconi Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Watt LE and Marconi Hi mechanical platforms, integrating with CISS for the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and investment by building on proven platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New product must pass all system integration tests with Watt LE/Marconi Hi base and CISS.

requirements.Title: Print Speed Requirements
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 20 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) mode.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive print speed is essential for market positioning in SMB and enterprise segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must achieve 25 ppm (standard) and 20 ppm (PDL) in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Support a new warranty page life target of 80,000 pages for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with new market expectations and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product must meet warranty requirements for 80,000 pages printed under standard conditions.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington industrial design with an increased tank size, but no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and aligns with new bottle sizes.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis redesign, ID approval
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: ID must be approved and tank must accommodate new bottle sizes as specified.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product safety during shipping and aligns with sustainability requirements (EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product must pass drop and vibration tests with EPS foam packaging.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Modifications
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates increased tank size and ensures smooth paper handling.
requirements.Dependencies: Tray and tank design, mechanical integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays must function without interference and pass paper handling reliability tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3-inch CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) on the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interaction and supports advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display must be functional and pass usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform with Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink flow and supports increased tank and page life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink flow must meet print speed and reliability targets using new tube configuration.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement service station aerosol management and make necessary changes to the spit platform due to the new tank.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces contamination and maintains print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and spit platform redesign
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol emissions must remain within HP and regulatory limits during operation.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube configuration and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage must operate within designed force limits and pass reliability tests with new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design paper path to support increased page life target of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Reliability of paper handling over extended life is crucial for warranty and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path must pass 80,000-page reliability test with no major jams or failures.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part
requirements.Description: Make ink maintenance a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates maintenance and extends product life beyond warranty period.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service center must be able to replace ink maintenance part post-80,000 pages as per service manual.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for the ink delivery system (IDS), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, supports new bottle sizes, and enhances system security.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and LEBI design, SHAID integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS must pass all fluidic and electrical connection reliability tests with new configuration.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management for improved reliability and startup performance.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent startup and minimizes air-related print defects.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must achieve successful startup and air purge in 99% of test cycles.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality goals and ink depletion definitions to align with page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product meets customer expectations for output quality and consumable life.
requirements.Dependencies: PQ test development, ink system calibration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product must meet defined PQ metrics and depletion points in validation tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components must pass full system integration and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Enables modern wireless features required by SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must connect to Wi-Fi and pass wireless certification tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security for Hardware and Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Meets HP and industry security standards for enterprise and SMB markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product must pass all HP security certification and penetration tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel standards for environmental and energy efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Required for market access and sustainability commitments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product must be certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel before launch.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and aligns with HP’s strategic intent.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All business models and onboarding paths must be validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Scan and SMB/Enterprise Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution and SMB manageability features, with enterprise support for WJA (Web Jetadmin), HPSM (HP Smart Management), and JAM (Job Accounting Manager).
requirements.Rationale: Enhances value proposition for business and enterprise customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution development, integration with HP software stack
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed manageability and scan features must be available and pass functional validation.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility with HP ecosystems and customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers and clients must install and function correctly on supported OS.

requirements.Title: Strategic Protection of Micro/SMB Segments
requirements.Description: Implement features and pricing to protect HP’s micro and SMB segments, safeguarding traditional ink/laser profit pools from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for HP’s market share retention and profitability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market analysis shows retention or growth in micro/SMB segment after launch.

requirements.Title: LaserJet Leadership and PDL Flanking
requirements.Description: Lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in medium and enterprise segments to win over competitors as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Strategic positioning to grow CISS share and compete with Epson.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product launch plan aligns with strategic positioning and initial sales targets are met.

requirements.Title: CISS Profitable Share Growth in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS offerings to new profitable market segments.
requirements.Rationale: Drives revenue growth and leverages CISS technology investments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product launched in at least one new segment with positive ROI.

requirements.Title: Highly Leveraged Development Approach
requirements.Description: Leverage Watt-LE mech platform, Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID), and solutions for rapid development and low investment.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes risk and cost while accelerating time-to-market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Development schedule milestones met with reuse of major components.

requirements.Title: Schedule Constraint – High Priority
requirements.Description: Maintain schedule as the least flexible constraint for the program, with defined checkpoints and milestones.
requirements.Rationale: On-time delivery is critical for market competitiveness and financial targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All critical milestones met as per published schedule.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Set SuperAmp PHA life at 65,000 pages as a fixed constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consumable life aligns with system reliability and service intervals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA must achieve 65,000-page life in validation testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Support warranty life of 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with customer expectations and competitive offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and system must support the stated warranty terms.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 PPM (PDL)
requirements.Description: Maintain throughput of 25/20 ppm for PDL as an optimization priority.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains competitiveness in performance-sensitive segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Throughput validated at 25/20 ppm in PDL mode in system tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Optimize for serviceability, particularly regarding the maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service downtime and cost, improves user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box must be easily replaceable and pass serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize product features and solutions for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses key needs of a major target segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB-specific features validated with pilot customers.

requirements.Title: PaaS Schedule Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize schedule for Platform as a Service (PaaS) offering.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns product launch with business model rollout.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS available at launch and validated with initial customers.
